description: This file contains mock and wrapper implementations for IPC and Dobby container proxy classes used in testing. It includes header files, defines several methods for container control, IPC service creation, and mock expectations, primarily used for unit tests involving container management and IPC communication.

classes.name: DobbyProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for controlling container instances via IPC, providing methods to manage container lifecycle and configuration.

classes.name: IpcService
classes.description: Implementation of an IPC service wrapper that enables starting, stopping, and querying the IPC connection.

methods.name: createIpcService
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a shared pointer to an IIpcService instance.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets or resets the internal implementation pointer for the proxy or service.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the container or service.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks if the container or service is responsive.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the container is alive, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: setLogMethod
methods.description: Sets the logging method for the container.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Adjusts the log level for container logs.

methods.name: setAIDbusAddress
methods.description: Configures the D-Bus address for AI communication.

methods.name: startContainerFromSpec
methods.description: Starts a container based on a JSON specification.

methods.name: startContainerFromBundle
methods.description: Starts a container from a bundle path.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: execInContainer
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a container.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for container state changes.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Gets information about a specific container.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by the proxy.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the IPC connection or service is valid.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes any buffered IPC messages.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the IPC service.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the IPC service.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific IPC service is available.

methods.name: getBusAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the D-Bus address used for IPC.
